_comment: exp/nextgen-fin Grid B -- WITH BIAX. Same skeleton as designs_nextgen_nobiax.json, but the torsional +-45 layers are hexcel_himax_biax_100 @ 45 (a would-be purchase). NOTE: in materials/from_shop.csv the biax card is a stand-in byte-identical to twill_3k_198 -- so vs Grid A this only changes the +-45 ply thickness (0.12 vs 0.2376 mm cured), i.e. finer flex/kick resolution, not fibre stiffness. See NEXTGEN.md.
_geometry_note: FIN_TEST_3.step, long axis +y, clamp at HEAL. QUARTER 0-15%, MID 0-39%, z_3_4ths 0-68%, TIP 84-100%. FULL whole blade. HEAL inside the fixture -- omitted.
_knobs: core = flex knob. pads.MID = kick knob. A [biax@45] ply in the core is the twist knob. QUARTER and TIP pads fixed.
_materials: hexcel_uni_231 is now an IM UD card (E1=153 GPa, IM446-grade ~43 Msi fibre, constants reused from hexcel_im2_uni_193). twill_3k_198 and the hexcel_himax_biax_100 stand-in unchanged (E1=59 GPa woven).
_targets: baseline = plybook_shop_measured re-solve 2026-09-10: flex W(90)=15.52 N, kick MID f=0.46, k_twist=16249 N.mm/rad at theta_at_probe=118.3 deg. TARGET: flex ~13.5 N (baseline-2), kick MID, k_twist>16249 at a matched theta.
